items.title: William Draper, Pioneering Silicon Valley Venture Capitalist, Dies at 98
items.teaser: He searched the fruit orchards south of San Francisco looking for startup companies to fund.

items.title: Investors Turn to Safety of Treasurys as Tech Stocks Extend Selloff
items.teaser: Fears around the AI trade sent tech stocks slumping for a second day and investors turned to government bonds for safety.

items.title: Oil Prices Mixed as Traders Weigh Demand Outlook, Hormuz Shipping Risks
items.teaser: Oil prices traded mixed as investors weighed a weaker global demand outlook and signs of recovering Middle East crude supplies against persistent shipping risks around the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Penske Automotive Group to Be Taken Private by Penske, Mitsui
items.teaser: Penske Automotive Group has agreed to be taken private by the transportation-services company’s biggest investors for about $4 billion.

items.title: PNC Revenue Rises on National Expansion
items.teaser: PNC Financial Services Group recorded higher revenue, but came in short of Wall Street’s estimates, as profit was dented by $36 million in integration costs tied to its acquisition of FirstBank.

items.title: New Private-Equity Firm Specializes in Giving Companies AI Glow-Ups
items.teaser: Aldaron, with co-founders coming from Palantir and Carlyle, recently closed its debut fund and made its first investment.

items.title: Ericsson Shares Surge on Strong Sales of Network Gear
items.teaser: Investors shrugged off the Swedish telecommunications-equipment maker’s warning that higher component costs will be a headwind to profitability next year.

items.title: TSMC Weighs Texas Expansion, Holds Talks on Musk’s Terafab
items.teaser: The world’s largest contract chip maker signaled its willingness to participate in large-scale AI infrastructure projects.

items.title: Thames Water Seeks £2.4 Billion More Funds to Keep Operating
items.teaser: Thames Water is seeking to raise £2.4 billion ($3.2 billion) of additional funding from its creditors to stay afloat while it negotiates a long-term solution for its debt burden.

items.title: GTCR, Elliott Acquire Software Firm CCC for $4.6 Billion
items.teaser: GTCR and Elliott Investment Management are acquiring car-insurance software provider CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. for about $4.6 billion.

items.title: Defense Stock Rout Lures Dip Buyers Looking Past US Election
items.teaser: A quick and painful selloff in shares of companies that make military equipment, missiles and planes is attracting investors who are betting the stocks will have an open runway once the midterm elections are over and fuel prices normalize.
